create.name: Cory Muscara
create.bio:
Cory Muscara is a mindfulness teacher whose path began in Burma in 2012, where he spent six months in silent Vipassana practice ordained as a monk with the teacher Sayadaw U Pandita, in the Mahasi line of Theravada Buddhism. He later completed the two-year Community Dharma Leader programme at Spirit Rock and trained in mindfulness-based approaches, relational meditation and yoga. He has taught leadership through mindfulness at Columbia and positive psychology at the University of Pennsylvania, where he has for years run a day-long workshop on guiding meditation.

His teaching aims to make contemplative practice plain and usable in daily life. He writes and speaks about presence, letting go, self-love and the way thoughts shape experience, and he hosts the Practicing Human podcast. His book Stop Missing Your Life is a guide to being more present. Alongside keynotes and retreats, he offers recorded online courses and masterclasses, a training for people who want to lead meditation, a weekday text message of reflection, and a free thirty-day course on letting go, reconnecting and creating a life from inner alignment. His guided meditations also appear on several meditation apps.

books.title: Stop Missing Your Life: How to Be Deeply Present in an Un-Present World
books.author: Cory Muscara
books.description: His guide to presence, drawing on his years of meditation practice and teaching. It offers practical ways to stop living on autopilot and meet everyday life more fully.

courses.title: How to Lead a Meditation
courses.description: A recorded training based on the day-long workshop he has run for years for University of Pennsylvania graduate students. It teaches how to guide one person or a group in meditation.

courses.title: Masterclass: Self-Love
courses.description: A recorded ninety-minute masterclass on why self-love matters and how to practise it day to day, with prompts and follow-up material.

courses.title: Daily Texts
courses.description: A short reflection from Cory sent by text message each weekday morning. Meant as a quiet start to the day without opening an app.

free_resources.title: Start Fresh: A 30-Day Course
free_resources.description: A free thirty-day video course in three parts: letting go, reconnecting with yourself and creating from inner alignment. Each day is a short teaching with practice.
